title: 1:1 prep - Julia Wright (report: Marcus Lee)
content:
Goal: 30-min 1:1 to sync on priorities, unblock, and short-term growth steps. Focus: Marcus' top blockers for Dedicated autoscaling feature, career check-in, and alignment on Q2 OKRs.

Agenda:
- (5m) Quick personal check-in / energy + highlights
- (10m) Status on autoscaler work (JIRA-PLAT-789) — what's done, what's at risk
- (7m) Blockers + ask for help (infra capacity, RFC review, SRE time)
- (5m) Career / growth check — skills to develop, stretch assignment
- (3m) Action items and next sync scheduling

Prep notes (from Marcus last update):
- Autoscaler prototype merged to feature branch; integration tests failing intermittently on long sequence workloads (seen in test-run-2026-02-20).
- Performance regression when KV cache warmup aligned w/ batch fusion — suspected race in cache invalidation logic.
- Blocked on infra quota to run larger scale soak (need additional 4x GPUs for 48h). Ticket opened with infra: JIRA-PLAT-801 (waiting on approval).
- Needs 2 hours of SRE pairing to debug flaky e2e tests — SRE availability limited this week.

Manager prompts / questions to ask Marcus:
- Walk me through the failing test pattern (when does it happen, consistent repro, repro time).
- Do you have a minimal repro and which logs/metrics we should look at first (KV hits, batch sizes)?
- If infra quota isn't approved, what are mitigation steps? Can we shard the soak or run on smaller seq lengths to isolate issue?
- How would you prioritize between stabilization vs. performance optimization for the next sprint? Which delivers more value to customers?
- Career: which ownership areas do you want more of? Do you want to lead the rollout playbook for Dedicated autoscaling (customer-facing docs + runbook)?

Risk signals to watch during the conversation:
- Marcus defers decisions or repeatedly asks for more time — may indicate bandwidth overload.
- Repro is flaky and test failures not correlated to a single change — could be infra timing issue or flaky test harness.
- SRE can't allocate pairing time this sprint — need plan B (PRR/observability spike).

Proposed asks / what I can do as manager:
- Prioritize infra quota request: I'll escalate to infra lead (Samira Kahn) and add context on customer impact. (Action: escalate by EOD).
- Coordinate 2-3 SRE pairing sessions next week — I'll block time with SRE lead. (Action: schedule today).
- Offer help triaging logs and setting up a targeted dashboard (KV hit rate, batch size distribution, latency P95) — I can pair 1 hour tomorrow morning. (Action: confirm time).
- If repro remains flaky, propose a short spike (2 devs x 2 days) to harden tests and add better determinism — ask Marcus if he wants to nominate a partner.

Career / growth notes (quick):
- Marcus interested in expanding cross-team influence (docs + runbooks, owning rollout). Recommend short-term stretch: own the rollout playbook for autoscaler, produce a publish-ready doc + runbook and lead a post-mortem on the soak.
- Skill area to develop: system observability (SLO design, telemetry instrumentation). Suggest pairing w/ observability team on a small ticket.

Action items (record during 1:1) — pre-filled suggestions:
- [Manager] Escalate infra quota (JIRA-PLAT-801) to Samira Kahn and request priority approval by 2026-03-04. (owner: Julia Wright, due: 2026-03-04)
- [Manager] Block 2x SRE pairing slots next week (owner: Julia Wright, due: 2026-03-05)
- [Marcus] Create minimal repro steps and attach to JIRA-PLAT-789; include which logs/metrics to check (owner: Marcus Lee, due: 2026-03-06)
- [Marcus] Draft rollout playbook outline for autoscaler (1st pass) — include runbook, rollback plan, telemetry checks (owner: Marcus Lee, due: 2026-03-20)
- [Both] Schedule follow-up 1:1 in 1 week to review progress and infra decision (owner: Julia Wright, due: 2026-03-10)

Notes to self post-meeting (placeholders):
- If infra quota denied, propose alternative soak: run 3x smaller concurrency runs staggered; evaluate if that reproduces regression.
- Check with SRE on triage priority: if not available, consider contracting 1-day consultant or rotating on-call dev time.
- Follow up on Marcus' interest in runbooks: find 2 examples from Dedicated and internal launch docs to share. Confluence refs: CONFLUENCE-ENG-1234 (deployment playbook).

Loose thoughts / TODO (scratch):
- Consider carving an observability spike ticket (2w) to add determinism to e2e tests — possible OKR candidate.
- Add a short checklist to PR template for autoscaler: list of environments to run, minimal metrics to capture, tags for flaky test detection.

Potential questions to bring up if time allows:
- How are you feeling about ownership balance between feature dev + oncall?
- Any blockers from product/PM side for rollout timing? (check with Priya, product-hosted-api)
- Do you feel you have the right level of mentorship right now?

End of doc.
